title: Clock controlled test step 1: Ubuntu systemd-timesyncd stopped by the Director, 20-minute settle measurement
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Clock controlled test step 1 (admin, Director-run command). The Director stopped Ubuntu systemd-timesyncd at 2026-10-19T00:58:41Z (systemd InactiveEnterTimestamp); it stays enabled. A read-only host settle logger (adjtimex modes=0; REALTIME/MONOTONIC/MONOTONIC_RAW every 0.1 s) ran 1,200 s from 00:59:33Z. Calendar steps became single (29 steps, one per ~29.8 s, no second timesyncd step) and shrank from -660.6 ms to -5.4 ms; none above 5 ms after 846 s. chronyd's applied correction fell from +27,140 ppm (tick 10271) to tick 10001 and about +50 ppm by about 15 minutes; the measured monotonic-versus-raw rate over each of the last 15 intervals was 42-55 ppm. No WSL restart was needed (plan step 2 skipped).

Second read-only host window, 1,200 s from 01:34:25Z, after the pipeline run: no calendar step above 5 ms, calendar minus monotonic -52.0 ms in total (plan limit 1 s), tick steady at 10001, measured correction 27-50 ppm (median 42). Acceptance: the 20-minute window and the long exact-timing receipt are met; the sleep/wake re-check is open.

RUN-20261019-001 read-only kernel clock probe in the container, 120 s: passed with exact timing (no clock discontinuity); tick 10001, applied +49 to +58 ppm, no calendar step above 50 ms, calendar minus monotonic -6.4 ms, chronyd estimated error 99 microseconds (49,691 at the start of the settle window).

RUN-20261019-002 local isolated BOOT-03 pipeline (python3 scripts/ci-local.py, disposable project lorcana-ci-6e031bdeb09240df88ca1c0fa835dd44): passed every stage in 461.7 s with exact timing, covering frozen install, 408 Node tests in 20 suites, upstream engine 406 passed/1 skipped, 2 injection tests, Python tooling, disposable PostgreSQL 18 provisioning, 11 Chromium tests, both secret scans, artifact verification and cleanup. Log reviewed: no credential patterns. Local isolated runs RUN-20261012-089/091, RUN-20261013-011/113 and RUN-20261014-051 had failed clock_changed.
Clock investigation section 'Controlled test step 1 — 2026-10-19 UTC'; dated clock notes appended to the current-status paragraphs of AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md; handoff rewritten.
